verseGurmukhi: ਹਮ ਸਰਿ ਦੀਨੁ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਨ ਤੁਮ ਸਰਿ ਅਬ ਪਤੀਆਰੁ ਕਿਆ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
verseTranslation: There is none as forlorn as I am, and none as Compassionate as You; what need is there to test us now?

verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਸਰਿ ਦੀਨੁ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਨ ਤੁਮ ਸਰਿ ਅਬ ਪਤੀਆਰੁ ਕਿਆ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translation: There is none as forlorn as I am, and none as Compassionate as You; what need is there to test us now?

verses.gurmukhi: ਬਚਨੀ ਤੋਰ ਮੋਰ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨੈ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਪੂਰਨੁ ਦੀਜੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translation: May my mind surrender to Your Word; please, bless Your humble servant with this perfection. ||1||

verses.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ਰਮਈਆ ਕਾਰਨੇ ॥
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice to the Lord.
O Lord, why are You silent? ||Pause||

verses.gurmukhi: ਬਹੁਤ ਜਨਮ ਬਿਛੁਰੇ ਥੇ ਮਾਧਉ ਇਹੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੇ ਲੇਖੇ ॥
verses.translation: For so many incarnations, I have been separated from You, Lord; I dedicate this life to You.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਆਸ ਲਗਿ ਜੀਵਉ ਚਿਰ ਭਇਓ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਖੇ ॥੨॥੧॥
verses.translation: Says Ravi Daas: placing my hopes in You, I live; it is so long since I have gazed upon the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan. ||2||1||
